# granola-to-minutes

> CLI tool that exports Granola meeting data (AI summaries, transcripts, notes) to Minutes-native markdown with YAML frontmatter.

## What it does

Extracts meeting metadata, AI-generated summaries, human notes, and transcripts
from Granola's server-side storage via granola-cli. Converts ProseMirror JSON to
markdown. Writes Minutes-compatible files with YAML frontmatter (title, date,
duration, attendees, speaker map).

## Install

npx granola-to-minutes export

## Key features

- Full export: metadata, AI summaries, transcripts, human notes
- Minutes-native markdown with YAML frontmatter
- Optional Claude-powered extraction of action items and decisions
- Dry-run, single-meeting, date-filtered, and JSON output modes
- Atomic file writes with collision handling
